summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its ResNexus engine: $50 base / $55 larger sites (2026, one night Tuesday or Saturday), water+sewer, reservable online. Added year-round season, a pull-through, showers/dump/laundry/wifi. Note trimmed of the rates and RV Life line the fields hold. Not stated: electric amperage (the engine's 20/30/50 filter is generic), site count, max rig length.
flags: Price gate, at the line: base $50.00 + tax for a plain full-hookup site (ResNexus, 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-14), so exactly US$50 before tax. No gateway within 40 km (Shenandoah NP 53 km); the family has not stayed here; Good Sam recorded false.

Long-stay mix (for information): 'Camper storage and permanent sites are now available', monthly and permanent sites 'Call for Price'. Nights are sold online to anyone, so it passes the nights-for-sale test.
